title: 2105. Dijkstra Algorithm – Shortest Distance from Source

Dijkstra Algorithm – Shortest Distance from Source
30
Easy
Problem Statement
Given a weighted undirected graph represented as an adjacency matrix, find the shortest distance from a given source vertex to all other vertices using Dijkstra's algorithm.
Input Format
- First line contains an integer n representing the number of vertices.
- Next n lines contain n integers each representing the adjacency matrix.
- Last line contains the source vertex s.
Output Format
Print the shortest distance from the source vertex to every vertex, one per line. Print -1 for unreachable vertices.
Constraints
- 1 ≤ n ≤ 100
- 0 ≤ weight ≤ 10^5
- Vertices are 0-indexed
